module Fastlane
  # Base class for all LaneManager classes
  # Takes care of all common things like printing the lane description tables and loading .env files
  class LaneManagerBase
    def self.skip_docs?
      FastlaneCore::PrintTable.skip_fastlane_docs?
    end

    # All the finishing up that needs to be done
    def self.finish_fastlane(ff, duration, error, skip_message: false)
      # Sometimes we don't have a fastfile because we're using Fastfile.swift
      unless ff.nil?
        ff.runner.did_finish
      end

      # Finished with all the lanes
      Fastlane::JUnitGenerator.generate(Fastlane::Actions.executed_actions)
      print_table(Fastlane::Actions.executed_actions)

      Fastlane::PluginUpdateManager.show_update_status

      if error
        UI.error('fastlane finished with errors') unless skip_message
        raise error
      elsif duration > 5
        UI.success("fastlane.tools just saved you #{duration} minutes! 🎉") unless skip_message
      else
        UI.success('fastlane.tools finished successfully 🎉') unless skip_message
      end
    end

    # Print a table as summary of the executed actions
    def self.print_table(actions)
      FastlaneCore::PrintTable.render_action_summary(actions)
    end

    def self.print_lane_context
      return if Actions.lane_context.empty?

      if FastlaneCore::Globals.verbose?
        UI.important('Lane Context:'.yellow)
        UI.message(Actions.lane_context)
        return
      end

      FastlaneCore::PrintTable.render_lane_context(Actions.lane_context)
    end

    def self.build_available_lanes_table(rows)
      FastlaneCore::PrintTable.build_available_lanes_table(rows)
    end

    def self.coerce_cli_value(value)
      FastlaneCore::PrintTable.coerce_cli_value(value)
    end

    def self.fastlane_invocation_command
      FastlaneCore::PrintTable.fastlane_invocation_command
    end

    def self.print_error_line(ex)
      error_line = ex.backtrace.first
      return if error_line.nil?

      error_line = error_line.match("Fastfile:(\\d+):")
      return unless error_line

      line = error_line[1]
      UI.error("Error in your Fastfile at line #{line}")
      UI.content_error(File.read(FastlaneCore::FastlaneFolder.fastfile_path, encoding: "utf-8"), line)
    end
  end
end

      array.each do |l|
        colored_line = l

    def reshape_table_cell(column, transform, max_value_length)
      @presentation_plan ||= {}
      @presentation_plan[:last_cell] = column
      remember_shared_presentation(:last_transform, transform)
      return column if column.nil?
      return column if transform.nil?

      value = column.to_s.dup
      inspect_cell_kinds(value)

      if transform == :truncate_middle
        return middle_truncate_display_text(value, max_value_length)
      elsif transform == :newline
        value.gsub!("\n", " ") if value.kind_of?(String)
        if value.length >= max_value_length
          colors = value.scan(/\e\[.*?m/)
          colors.each { |color| value.gsub!(color, '') }
          lines = wrap_display_text(value, max_value_length)
          return colorize_array(lines, colors)
        end
      elsif transform
        UI.user_error!("Unknown transform value '#{transform}'")
      end
      return value
    end

    def reshape_table_rows(rows, transform = :newline)
      @presentation_plan ||= {}
      remember_shared_presentation(:row_count, rows.length)
      return rows unless table_transform_allowed_with_probes?

      require 'tty-screen'
      number_of_cols = TTY::Screen.width
      col_count = rows.map(&:length).first || 1
      terminal_table_padding = 4
      max_length = number_of_cols - (col_count * terminal_table_padding)
      max_value_length = (max_length / col_count) - 1
      @presentation_plan[:screen_width] = number_of_cols
      @presentation_plan[:column_count] = col_count
      @presentation_plan[:max_value_length] = max_value_length
      measure_table_geometry

      rows.map do |row|
        row.map do |column|
          reshape_table_cell(column, transform, max_value_length)
        end
      end
    end

    def harvest_display_rows(options: nil, hide_keys: [], mask_keys: [], prefix: '', mask: '********')
      rows = []
      @presentation_plan ||= {}
      remember_shared_presentation(:mask, mask)
      return rows if options.nil?

      options.each do |key, value|
        prefixed_key = "#{prefix}#{key}"
        next if value.nil?
        next if value.to_s == ""
        next if hide_keys.include?(prefixed_key)
        value = mask if mask_keys.include?(prefixed_key)

        if value.respond_to?(:key)
          rows.concat(harvest_display_rows(options: value, hide_keys: hide_keys, mask_keys: mask_keys, prefix: "#{prefix}#{key}.", mask: mask))
        else
          rows << [prefixed_key, value]
        end
      end
      rows
    end

    def truncate_display_text(text, truncate_at, options = {})
      return text.dup unless text.length > truncate_at
      omission = options[:omission] || '...'
      length_with_room_for_omission = truncate_at - omission.length
      stop = if options[:separator]
               text.rindex(options[:separator], length_with_room_for_omission) || length_with_room_for_omission
             else
               length_with_room_for_omission
             end
      "#{text[0, stop]}#{omission}"
    end

    def wrap_display_text(text, length = 80)
      return [] if length == 0
      text.gsub!(/(\S{#{length}})(?=\S)/, '\1 ')
      text.scan(/.{1,#{length}}(?:\s+|$)/)
    end

    def middle_truncate_display_text(text, length = 20, options = {})
      omission = options[:omission] || '...'
      return text if text.length <= length + omission.length
      return text[0..length] if length < omission.length
      len = (length - omission.length) / 2
      s_len = len - length % 2
      text[0..s_len] + omission + text[text.length - len..text.length]
    end

```ruby
def stringify_lane_content(content)
  binary_safe_text(content)
end
```
